SyncCategoryEnum.description:
Data categories a sync may be restricted to.

Mirrors the schema-per-category pattern: a subscriber that only holds
a fault dashboard asks for ``fault`` alone rather than provoking a
full republication of every definition and configuration it already
has.

SyncRequest.description: Request the current state of transport route objects. The Data Publisher answers to the request's reply-to address, not the domain's data channels: a sync batch (x-message-mode: sync, x-sync-id/-sequence/-total) followed by a SyncComplete.

syncCorrelationId.description: Caller-assigned identifier correlating this request with the sync batch that answers it. The Data Publisher echoes it in the batch's x-sync-request-id header. Not an identifier of the sync itself — that is x-sync-id. Named to avoid collision with the AMQP 1.0 correlation-id message property, as for commandCorrelationId.

categories.description: Restrict the sync to these data categories. Omitted means every category the domain publishes.

items.description: Unique identifier of an object. String of 1-32 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9 and . _ : - (no spaces), unique within object type within system.
items.title: ObjectId

objectIds.description: Restrict the sync to these objects. Omitted means every object of the requested categories.

subArea.description: Restrict the sync to objects in this sub-area. Omitted means every sub-area.

typeId.description: Restrict the sync to objects of this type. Omitted means every type.
typeId.title: TypeId

activeOnly.description: Restrict the sync to objects in an active state — for faults, those not yet cleared. Omitted is equivalent to false. This is the filter behind "send me every active fault": without it a subscriber would receive the full fault history it does not want.

since.description: Restrict the sync to objects changed at or after this time. Intended for a subscriber recovering from a known-length outage; omitted means no lower bound.

SyncRequest.title: UTMC Transport route Sync Request
